name: AI engineer (applied / LLM)
oneLiner: The single fastest-growing job title in the US, two years running.
why: Integration and evaluation work that requires judgement about reliability
Every AI deployment creates maintenance and monitoring obligations
threats: Titles age fast in this space — the same work was 'ML engineer' five years ago
A crowded on-ramp: it demands production engineering skill, not curiosity

claims.text: AI engineer ranks first among LinkedIn's fastest-growing US job titles, having held the top spot for a second year.
AI-specialist job postings grew 68.9% in 2025 while total job growth was 8.6%; globally there are now 10.7 AI specialist postings for every one in 2012.
The average wage premium for workers with AI skills reached 62%, up from 57% a year earlier.
